evidence.quote: cRNA was hybridized onto Illumina Human HT-12v3 Expression BeadChips (Illumina), following the manufacturer’s protocol.
Hemagglutination inhibition (HAI) tests were performed as previously described [20], except for a starting serum sample dilution of 1:4 and the use of turkey red blood cells (RBCs).
Neutralizing antibody tests were performed as previously described [21] except that hamster serum was not included.

Spectrophotometry (NanoDrop-1000 Spectrophotometer, Thermo Fisher Scientific) and microfluidic electrophoresis (Experion Automated Electrophoresis System, Bio-Rad Laboratories) were used for quality control.
